transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I came because my family and friends keep acting like I’m wrong. They keep saying the bank papers show nothing was taken, but I know my money is being hidden. It’s been going on for over a year.

They use things like bills, fundraisers, and planning trips to cover it up, and then they tell me I’m making it up. I just need them to tell the truth, so I keep confronting them about it.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually energetic or needed much less sleep than usual?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have times I’m upset and can’t settle down, but I wouldn’t say I suddenly have a bunch of energy or don’t need sleep.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices like that when nobody was there.
Aside from the money issue, have other people said that your speech or behavior seems disorganized or hard to follow?
No, not really. I mean, people say I talk too much about the money, but I don’t think they say I’m hard to follow. I think they just don’t want to hear it.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological condition that you think might be related to this?
No, not that I know of. I haven’t been told I have anything medical or with my nerves or brain that would explain it.
Have you found yourself caring much less than usual about seeing people or doing things you used to enjoy?
I don’t think so. I mean, I still like being around people sometimes and doing things I enjoy. I may keep to myself when I’m stressed, but I haven’t really noticed not caring about those things.
Is it possible that someone is secretly taking or hiding your money?

Yes. I mean, I’m sure of it. For over a year I’ve known they’re hiding my money. My family and friends keep saying the bank papers don’t show anything was taken, but that doesn’t prove it to me. They use bills, fundraisers, even trip plans to cover where it’s going. That’s why I keep confronting them—I just want them to tell the truth.
Do you believe anyone is controlling your thoughts or putting thoughts into your mind?
No… I don’t think anyone is controlling my thoughts or putting thoughts in my head. My thoughts feel like they’re mine.
During this time, have you had a period when you felt unusually depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure… I don’t think I’ve been depressed most of the day nearly every day. I get upset and stressed, but I wouldn’t call it that.
When this started, was there ever a time you felt euphoric or unusually confident?
I don’t really know. I can’t say I felt euphoric. I might’ve felt more certain about things, but not like unusually happy or on top of the world.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see… not that I’ve noticed.
Other than your money being hidden, do you have any other strong beliefs that other people say are not true?

Yes… it’s not just the money sitting somewhere. I think they’re using bills and those fundraiser things, and even trip plans, to cover up what they did. My family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but I don’t believe that. I’ve known for over a year they’re hiding it, and I keep asking them because I need them to tell the truth.
During this time, have you had a period when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable?

I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve been upset and frustrated, but I wouldn’t say my mood was unusually high or anything like that. Irritable maybe sometimes, but not like a whole period where I felt different from myself.
Before this started, did you ever feel that ordinary events or comments were meant especially for you?
I’m not really sure what you mean. Before all this, I don’t think I felt like normal comments or things happening were specially about me. I didn’t notice anything like that.
Have other people told you that your thoughts or speech jump around so much that they can’t follow what you’re saying?
No, I don’t think anyone’s said that to me. Sometimes I get worked up and repeat myself, but I don’t think I jump around so much people can’t follow.
Have there been times when you were much more active than usual, starting lots of projects or doing far more than you normally would?
No, not really. I don’t think I’ve been starting a bunch of projects or doing way more than usual. I’ve mostly just been dealing with things as they come.
Has anyone ever told you that your belief about the money being hidden seems impossible, rather than just unlikely or mistaken?

Yes. My family and friends keep saying it’s impossible, that the bank papers show nothing was taken. But I know they’re hiding my money. It’s been going on over a year, and they use things like bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to cover it up. That’s why I keep confronting them—I need them to tell the truth.
Apart from the issue of your money, have you had any other experiences that made you feel people were against you or trying to harm you?
No, not really. I mean, I get upset about the money because I know something is going on there, but other than that I haven’t noticed people trying to hurt me or be against me.
Because of this, have you had trouble keeping up with your usual work or daily responsibilities?

No, not really. Besides the arguments about the money, I still do my regular things. I make my own meals, get myself to the county clinic and my assistance appointments, and keep my stuff in order like I always have.
Have you had a time when you felt emotionally flat, like your face and voice showed much less feeling than usual?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get upset sometimes, but I haven’t noticed my face or voice being flat like that.
